design.css: .frame { width: 100%; height: 100vh; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 34px; background: var(--fs-backgroundColor); }.inner { height: 100%; box-sizing: border-box; border: 3px solid var(--fs-primaryColor); outline: 1px solid var(--fs-primaryColor); outline-offset: -12px; padding: 44px 72px 40px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; text-align: center; color: var(--fs-textColor); }.number { align-self: flex-start; color: var(--fs-mutedColor); font-size: 16px; }h1 { margin: 6px 0 22px; font-size: 54px; letter-spacing: .5em; text-indent: .5em; color: var(--fs-textColor); }.who { margin: 0 0 4px; font-size: 22px; display: flex; gap: 18px; align-items: baseline; }.who .org { color: var(--fs-mutedColor); }.who strong { font-size: 34px; letter-spacing: .2em; }.course { margin: 0 0 18px; color: var(--fs-primaryColor); font-size: 21px; font-weight: 700; }.body { margin: 0; max-width: 720px; font-size: 19px; line-height: 1.9; }.date { margin: auto 0 8px; font-size: 18px; }.issuer { margin: 0; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: .08em; }
